mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN trx_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalPurchase, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN trx_type = 'SALE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalSale, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN trx_type = 'EXPENSE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalExpense, COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN trx_type = 'SALE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN trx_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN trx_type = 'EXPENSE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) , 0) AS netProfit FROM tb_ledger WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND trx_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM trx_date)::int AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM trx_date)::int AS month, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN trx_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalPurchase, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN trx_type = 'SALE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalSale, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN trx_type = 'EXPENSE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalExpense, COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN trx_type = 'SALE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN trx_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN trx_type = 'EXPENSE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) , 0) AS netProfit FROM tb_ledger WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND trx_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM trx_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM trx_date) ORDER BY year, month
